items.exampleEn: How do you spell your name?
Write with a pencil, not a pen.
items.exampleZh: 用鉛筆寫，不要用原子筆。

items.exampleEn: I write new words in my notebook.
items.exampleZh: 我把新單字寫在筆記本上。

items.exampleEn: Draw a line with a ruler.
You can find the word in a dictionary.
items.exampleZh: 你可以在字典裡找到這個字。

items.sentenceEn: I have a pencil and a ruler.
items.sentenceZh: 我有一枝鉛筆和一把尺。

items.audioEn: This word is hard to spell. Let's look in the dictionary.
items.audioZh: 這個字很難拼，我們查字典吧。
items.questionZh: 他們要用什麼來查這個字？

items.sentenceEn: Write the grammar notes in your notebook.
items.sentenceZh: 把文法筆記寫在你的筆記本上。

items.stemEn: How do you ____ your last name?
I use a ____ to draw a long line.

items.passageEn: Today is our first English class. The teacher tells us to bring a pencil, a notebook, and a dictionary every day. We read a short paragraph and learn some grammar. Then the teacher asks us to spell five new words. It is hard, but fun.
items.passageZh: 今天是我們的第一堂英文課。老師要我們每天帶鉛筆、筆記本和字典。我們讀了一小段文章，學了一些文法。接著老師要我們拼五個新單字。很難，但很好玩。

questions.questionZh: 老師要大家每天帶什麼？
options: 英文課本、電腦和計算機

questions.questionZh: 最後老師要大家做什麼？

rubricZh: 請求可用 Can I…?、May I…?、Could I…? 等
寫 Can I borrow your dictionary? 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 spell 造一個句子，問別人或說說某個字怎麼拼。
referenceEn: How do you spell your name?
I can spell the word dictionary.
rubricZh: 問拼法可用 How do you spell…?
spell 後面接要拼的字（例如 spell your name）
